derivation: from G2596 (κατά) and a derivative of G1349 (δίκη);
def: to adjudge against, i.e. pronounce guilty

occurrences.text: But if ye had known what this meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.
Judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven:
Ye have condemned and killed the just; and he doth not resist you.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
